newsitem.title: USA: U.S. tax cut bigger than previous estimates - aide.
newsitem.headline: U.S. tax cut bigger than previous estimates - aide.

text.p: U.S. tax legislation under consideration in Congress will cut taxes by a larger amount than earlier estimates, a congressional aide said Wednesday.
The net tax cut over five years would reach $95.2 billion, while the gross tax cut would reach $151.6 billion.
Over 10 years the net tax cut would come to $275.4 billion, and the gross tax cut $401 billion, the aide said.
The original May budget agreement between congressional leaders and the White House called for $85 billion in net tax cuts over five years and $250 billion over 10 years.
